There is a great book called "the power of habit" Charles duhig

It talks about how much habit run our lives.

So part of your driving, eating, shitting habits was the inclusion of a cigarette. Not having the cigarette makes the habit/routine of driving,eating etc seem incomplete.

So learn what makes you most want to smoke and find something to do instead. Make a new habit. Then over time you will associate driving, eating etc with the new habit and the "have a cigarette" voice will get quieter while the new habit voice will get louder.

After that first year and a half, I had a cigar, and have had one every 6-12 months since then. I don't feel like I'm depriving myself of something I enjoy any longer.
